summary: Mr. Arking discusses the different customs regarding whether to sit or stand when putting on tefillin shel yad and reciting the associated blessing. He reviews the teachings of the Arizal, the Ben Ish Hai, and the custom of Halab as recorded by Hakham Yosef Abadi Shaayo. The class also touches on the practice of covering the arm with a tallit while wrapping the strap.
questions: Should I sit or stand when putting on tefillin shel yad?
Is the blessing for tefillin recited while sitting or standing?
What is the custom of Halab regarding the blessing for tefillin?
Should I cover my arm with a tallit when wrapping the tefillin strap?
